_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#2 (a jump term over plain dx is rejected loudly; dx(skeleton=True) is interior facets, ds(skeleton=True) boundary facets). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, L2 order 1 dgjumps=True. The literal NgException text in the claim is exact, but the claim's stated failure point is NOT: the exception comes out of BilinearForm.__iadd__, before Assemble() is ever reached, so a guard wrapped around .Assemble() as the wording invites never sees it -- the fixture records the stage. The two skeleton measures are then told apart structurally: nze counts allocated slots and is identical for both on a dgjumps space, so entries that actually received a value are counted instead -- the interior-facet mass form writes 444 cross-element entries, the boundary-facet form writes 0 and stays block-diagonal. Mutation: writing the jump over dx(skeleton=True) in the wrong-variant block removes the exception and the fixture fails on plain_dx_message_literal and raised_at_iadd_not_assemble.
